rows.grounds: anāmā (ring finger) + aṅguṣṭha (thumb) + yoga (union), instrumental singular
causative optative of tṛp, third person singular

items.question: How should the Kula lineage be satisfied?
premises: The Kula lineage is the object.
items.inference: One satisfies the Kula lineage by ring-finger-thumb union.
uncertainties: Exact ritual referent of anāmā remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: With the union of ring finger and thumb, one should satisfy the Kula lineage.
